svg.title: Prisma ORM: The Most Downloaded ORM for Node.js and TypeScript
svg.desc: A four-column chart of npm downloads for Node.js ORMs over the 30 days to 5 July 2026: prisma 55.3M in cyan, drizzle-orm 48.1M, typeorm 19.3M and sequelize 11.8M in grey.
svg.text: ORM npm downloads, 30 days to 5 July 2026
